Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We Are
 Wizeline, a global AI-native technology solutions provider, develops cutting-edge, AI-powered digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and impact.
With the right people and the right ideas, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.
 Are you a fit?
 Sounds awesome, right? Now, let’s make sure you’re a good fit for the role:
Key Responsibilities
 Backend & Distributed Systems Development
Feature Implementation: Design, develop, and deliver new backend features and API integrations for a high-reliability banking platform using modern .NET (.NET 6/8) and C#.
Asynchronous & Event-Driven Workflows: Build and maintain decoupled, message-driven services (using brokered messaging such as Azure Service Bus topics and queues), applying foundational distributed patterns like idempotency and outbox/inbox where required.
Code Quality & Standards: Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code following SOLID and object-oriented programming principles.
 Testing, Observability & Production Operations 
Automated Testing: Champion strong automated testing practices by writing thorough unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to validate both synchronous APIs and asynchronous message flows.
Production Support & Monitoring: Actively participate in operating production services—leveraging logging, metrics, and alerting tools (e.g., Azure Application Insights) to investigate incidents, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and ensure performance under load.
CI/CD & Cloud Delivery: Contribute to and maintain build and release pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps) to support smooth, repeatable deployments on Azure.
 Collaboration & Technical Growth
Team Collaboration: Partner with Senior engineers, product owners, and cross-functional teams during technical refinements to clarify requirements and implement sound technical solutions.
Engineering Excellence: Participate constructively in code reviews, contribute to Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and help improve team development workflows.
 Must-have Skills
Core Backend Engineering: Proven production experience as a C# / .NET backend developer (.NET Core / .NET 6 / .NET 8) with a strong command of OOP principles and API integration (REST/internal & external APIs).
Distributed & Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience building distributed, asynchronous, or microservices-based systems using messaging brokers (ideally Azure Service Bus).
Production Azure Experience: Practical experience deploying, running, and troubleshooting backend applications in Azure cloud environments, including familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) and basic Infrastructure as Code concepts (e.g., Terraform).
Automated Testing: Strong background implementing automated test suites (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing).
Production Operations & Observability: Real-world experience supporting live services—working with structured logging, alerting, incident investigation, and performance/load considerations.
Communication & Language: English B2 Advanced or C1, with clear verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in an English-speaking engineering team.
 Nice-to-have
AI Tooling Proficiency: Leverage one or more AI tools to optimize and augment day-to-day work, including drafting, analysis, research, or process automation. Provide recommendations on effective AI use and identify opportunities to streamline workflows. 
Advanced Distributed Patterns: Exposure to resilience patterns (Circuit Breaker, retries with backoff, Sagas) and Event Sourcing. 
Performance & Scale: Experience running performance or load testing tools, as well as familiarity with Kubernetes (AKS) and Azure storage technologies. 
Domain & Workflow: Prior experience in banking, fintech, or payment processing systems, and familiarity with AI-assisted development tools to boost daily productivity.
 What we offer
Competitive compensation & total rewards. 
Health benefits & wellness programs. 
Savings & retirement plans. 
Global mobility opportunities. 
Flexible work policy and remote-friendly approach. 
Happy hours, gaming tournaments, sports activities & more. 
Continuous learning & training programs with WizeAcademy. 
Free certifications in cloud technologies and coding languages. 
 Find out more about our culture here.
